founder.name: Youssef Buobaid
founder.title: Chairman
founder.message: When we established SILSILAT AL-THIQA in 2013, we set out to serve a growing need at the heart of the Kingdom's industrial sector. Concrete, steel and piping assets were degrading under severe operational and chemical stress, with operators left with no option other than costly demolition and replacement. We chose a different path — advanced composite repair, high-strength CFRP wrapping, and chemical-resistant lining systems that restore structural integrity and extend asset life without prolonged shutdowns. True engineering leadership is measured not only by what we deliver, but by what we enable our clients to achieve: operational continuity, asset protection, and sustainable growth.

assessment.title: Assessment & Diagnostics
assessment.body: Engineering diagnostics and asset integrity assessment to minimize operational and financial risk.
assessment.overview: Our Assessment & Diagnostics division utilizes state-of-the-art non-destructive testing (NDT) and advanced engineering analysis to evaluate the true condition of your industrial assets. We go beyond surface-level inspections to uncover hidden vulnerabilities in piping, concrete structures, and steel reinforcements. By quantifying corrosion rates, structural fatigue, and material degradation, we provide actionable data that allows you to address critical flaws before they lead to catastrophic failures or unplanned downtime.

rehabilitation.title: Structural Rehabilitation
rehabilitation.body: Restoring structural performance and extending asset life using advanced CFRP technologies without the need for replacement.
rehabilitation.overview: We specialize in the structural reinforcement of aging or compromised industrial infrastructure. Using advanced Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) wrap systems, we restore load-bearing capacities to columns, beams, and slabs without adding significant weight or altering dimensions. This trenchless, rapid-deployment technology is ASME PCC-2 compliant and specifically designed to rehabilitate process piping, silos, and critical plant structures with minimal disruption to your daily operations.
rehabilitation.secondaryImageCaption: Precision application of carbon fiber composite.

protection.title: Industrial Protection
protection.body: Protective systems and industrial coatings designed for extreme corrosion, chemical and abrasion resistance.
protection.overview: Industrial assets face relentless exposure to harsh chemicals, extreme temperatures, and mechanical abrasion. Our Industrial Protection services deploy high-performance epoxy coatings, acid-resistant linings, and heavy-duty polyurethanes designed to withstand the most severe environments. Whether lining a primary containment tank or coating offshore structural steel, our NACE-certified application teams ensure complete surface isolation, preventing aggressive corrosion and significantly extending the operational lifespan of your vital equipment.
protection.secondaryImageCaption: Application of highly durable chemical resistant epoxy.

endurance.title: Asset Endurance
endurance.body: Long-term asset integrity management for operational continuity and sustained performance.
endurance.overview: Asset Endurance is our holistic approach to facility maintenance. We don't just repair; we engineer long-term solutions that guarantee operational continuity for years to come. By combining predictive maintenance strategies with rapid-response repair capabilities, we help facility owners in the petrochemical, power, and manufacturing sectors maximize their return on investment. Our localized teams provide continuous support, ensuring your operations remain safe, efficient, and fully compliant with all regulatory standards.

faq.q: Can you work during a live plant shutdown?
faq.a: Yes. A large share of our CFRP and lining work is delivered inside operator turnaround (TAM) windows — including overnight and emergency mobilisations.

faq.q: Do you work on pressurised process piping?
faq.a: We carry out in-service leak repair and CFRP reinforcement on pressurised lines, engineered to the defect and the service conditions.

faq.q: Which acids are your linings rated for?
faq.a: Our composite carbon fiber lining systems are rated for 98% sulfuric acid and 54% phosphoric acid concentrations.

faq.q: Do you only execute or also sell materials?
faq.a: Both. We supply CFRP fabric (unidirectional and multi-directional, 150–900 GSM) for maintenance teams that prefer in-house execution.

advantages.title: Key Advantages
points: Long-term protection against moisture, salts, and weathering, suitable for highly corrosive industrial and marine environments.
Reduced maintenance costs and extended operational life of assets compared to traditional protection systems.
Fast application with minimal surface preparation, reducing downtime and operational costs.
High flexibility allowing for inspection, maintenance, and re-application without damaging components or disrupting operations.
Ideal for protecting flanges, bolts, valves, pipelines, and industrial equipment, fully environmentally certified and VOC-free.

oxifree.title: Oxifree TM198 Protective Coating
oxifree.desc: Removable thermoplastic polymeric coating that protects flanges, valves, bolts and plant equipment from corrosion, moisture and salts — engineered for the harshest industrial and marine environments.

systems.title: Three engineered material systems power every service we deliver
systems.desc: Assessment, Rehabilitation, Protection and Endurance are all delivered using one or more of the three material systems below — selected to match the asset, the environment and the service conditions.

sys1.name: Carbon Fiber (CFRP)
sys1.desc: Carbon-fibre reinforced polymer system for rehabilitating concrete, steel and process piping under ACI 440.2R and ASME PCC-2 / ISO 24817.

sys2.name: Oxifree TM198
sys2.desc: Removable thermoplastic polymeric coating that shields flanges, valves and metallic connections from corrosion, moisture and salts — with no shutdown required.

sys3.name: Fibreglass (GFRP)
sys3.desc: Glass-fibre reinforced polymer system for lining and repairing tanks, pipes and liquid-retaining structures — compliant with API 650 / 653 / 652.

field.title: Why CFRP for petrochemical piping
field.p1: CFRP/FRP delivers a durable solution that restores structural integrity — as either a permanent or bridging repair — which is critical in petrochemical plants where line downtime translates into major financial losses.
field.p2: Our interventions are designed to ACI 440.2R for concrete substrates and ASME PCC-2 / ISO 24817 for metallic substrates, and are executed by technicians certified by international suppliers — including emergency mobilisations that have averted catastrophic failures.
field.p3: Applications include: restoring load capacity of degraded members, upgrading structures to current seismic loading, strengthening intact elements against increased loads, and repairing active leaks on pipes and tanks without isolating the system.
